defaultHints: Try LOOK for Roger’s description of this place.
Examine a specific object from the description, then move close to it before trying an action.

1.name: Garbage freighter
hints: Watch the freighter collect Roger’s pod, or click the scene to skip ahead.

2.name: Junk bay

hints: The heavy object has moved. Look for it where the grabber last released its load.
The passage east and the scrap to the south both lead farther into the freighter.
The pod has finished its journey. Look at the floor around it.
Examine the small object on the floor. If it proves too heavy, remember where you saw it.

3.name: Scrap heap
hints: Look at the space between the wrecks. Some of the scrap conceals a way through.
A ladder can go with you. Try taking it when you’re beside it.

4.name: Bucket conveyor
hints: Watch where the buckets go. They carry scrap to a higher level.
Stand near a bucket and try getting into it. Be ready to move at the top.

5.name: Tanker wreck
hints: The dark passage through the tanker is worth exploring. Look inside.

6.name: Tanker interior
hints: Inspect the frayed wiring on the wall.
Get close to the one usable wire and take it.

7.name: Robot head
hints: Examine the metal head among the wrecks. Look for a way into it.

8.name: Aluminum Mallard
hints: Examine the ship and its hatch. What would let you reach the handle?
Bring the ladder over to the ship.

9.name: Upper conveyor
hints: The scrap is moving toward a shredder. Look above you for a safer route.

10.name: Shredder
hints: Act before the conveyor reaches the blades. Look for the rail above you.

11.name: Overhead rail
hints: Stay on the rail. The narrower section is especially treacherous on foot.

12.name: Rail junction
hints: Two passages lead west. Keep to the rail while exploring them.

13.name: Grabber station
hints: Inspect the seat and the grabber controls.
Stop the grabber over a load before using the claw.

14.name: Mallard cabin
hints: Check the status computer for the ship’s missing parts.
Look beneath the floor for the reactor compartment.

15.name: Debris hollow
hints: Follow the wires from the lamps to their power source.
Take the reactor before finding a way back up.

16.name: Status computer
hints: Read the diagnostic display. Each failed system corresponds to a repair the ship needs.

17.name: Flight controls
hints: Keep the radar running in flight. Use F6 to return to the cockpit view.

18.name: Combat display
hints: Keep an eye on your shield and the position of the incoming fighters.

19.name: Navigation computer
hints: Scan for a destination before setting your course.

20.name: Freighter departure
hints: There’s debris between you and open space. Check your shields before firing.

21.name: Planetary approach
hints: Watch the Mallard’s approach. Once it lands, check the conditions outside.

25.name: Order counter
hints: Read the menu and check how much cash you’re carrying.

27.name: Monolith Burger
hints: Dock at the restaurant and explore what’s inside.

28.name: Dining area
hints: Take a closer look at the arcade machine between meals.

29.name: Restaurant counter
hints: You’ll need cash to order. Check the menu when you reach the counter.

41.name: Desert plain
hints: The mountains lie to the north. Use the skyline to orient yourself.

42.name: Mog’s foot
hints: Walk around the giant foot and inspect its north end for an entrance.

43.name: Mog monument
hints: Inspect the entrances in the enormous feet. The two legs serve different purposes.

44.name: Desert sign
hints: Face the sign and move close enough to read it.

45.name: Sand dunes
hints: Use the larger dunes and distant landmarks to find your bearings.

46.name: Steep dunes
hints: Examine the depression before stepping into it.

47.name: Mog overlook
hints: The giant shape beyond the dune is mechanical. Head closer to investigate.

48.name: Rock formation
hints: Examine the opening in the rock before approaching it.

49.name: Phleebhut landing site
hints: Remember these rock formations. They mark the way back to the Mallard.

50.name: Rock spires
hints: Inspect the hole among the formations before getting too close.

51.name: Rocky desert
hints: Look at the hole from a safe distance, then explore around the rocks.

52.name: Rock overhang
hints: Inspect the pulsating pods from a safe distance. Consider how they might affect a pursuer.

53.name: Snake country
hints: Give the snake plenty of space. Look for another way around it.

54.name: Storm plain
hints: The storms mark the mountains to the north. Use them to keep your bearings.

60.name: Lava field
hints: Watch where the gas vents break through the surface. Give the bubbles room.

61.name: Ortega trail
hints: Explore along solid ground and keep clear of the lava.

62.name: Ortega landing site
hints: The planet is dangerously hot. Check what you’re wearing before exploring.

63.name: Ortega trail
hints: Look for a route between the volcanic formations. Keep the way back to your ship in mind.

64.name: Lava vents
hints: Watch the vents before choosing where to walk.

66.name: Lava crevice
hints: Inspect both edges. A metal pole could help you vault the gap.

67.name: Volcanic pass
hints: Follow the stretches of solid ground toward the volcano.

68.name: Volcanic vents
hints: Watch for activity in the lava before crossing this area.

69.name: Survey station
hints: Wait for the occupants to leave, then inspect their survey equipment.

70.name: Volcano base
hints: Look for a path up the volcano and pay attention to the scout ship.

71.name: Volcano slope
hints: Follow the climb toward the rim to see what’s inside the crater.

72.name: Crater rim
hints: Examine the machine and where it’s pointing. Follow the route down to it.

73.name: Generator base
hints: Look for a route up the generator. Inspect the platform and stairs.

74.name: Generator platform
hints: The ladder is the way to the top of the generator.

75.name: Generator summit
hints: Examine the opening at the top. Think about what you brought from the survey site.

80.name: Pestulon forest
hints: Look for a clearing among the tree-like growths.

81.name: ScumSoft clearing
hints: Watch the entrance from cover. Check your belt before approaching the guards.

85.name: ScumSoft entrance
hints: Keep moving while the belt has power. The guards are watching the approach.

86.name: Security ramp
hints: Inspect the wall beside the elevator door.

90.name: Janitor’s closet
hints: Look for a disguise and the equipment that goes with it.

91.name: Office corridor
hints: Act like you belong here. A janitor is expected to keep the office clean.

92.name: Copier room
hints: Look at the picture on the wall and the nearby color copier.

93.name: Executive cubicle
hints: Watch the boss’s movements. Inspect the desk when you have privacy.

94.name: Vehicle bay
hints: Locate your ship and remember the way back to this platform.

95.name: Detention platform
hints: Look for a way to extend the bridges before stepping into the shaft.

96.name: Robot arena
hints: Use the game screen. Arrow keys move, J punches, and M blocks. Watch your remaining power.

155.name: Sleep chamber
hints: Roger is waking up. Click the scene to skip ahead to the junk bay.

280.name: Monolith menu
hints: Check the prices against the buckazoids you have.

290.name: Astro Chicken
hints: Let the machine cycle through its instructions before inserting a buckazoid.

420.name: Mog elevator
hints: Inspect the buttons beside the elevator shaft.

421.name: Mog machinery
hints: Examine the moving equipment and how the elevator connects the levels.

470.name: World O’ Wonders
hints: Talk to Fester and examine his wares. Something you already own may interest him.

471.name: Postcard rack
hints: Look at each card for clues about places beyond the shop.

690.name: Observation scope
hints: Look where the beam meets the moon. It explains why an ordinary approach will fail.

777.name: Startup
hints: The game is checking its animation speed. The opening sequence follows.

900.name: Title sequence
hints: Click the game screen to skip the opening and follow Roger into the junk freighter.
